description: Find the Replo site to inspect, manage, or clone within a project. Each site returns clone_url, the URL used to clone that site's code over Git, and is_default. When the user does not name a site, use the site with is_default true; if no site is default, ask which one to use. Results are paginated: follow next_cursor until has_more is false before concluding a site does not exist. Site names are dashboard labels, not SEO page titles.
name: list_sites
title: List sites
